name: mccode2.5
description: Front-end build for McCode 2.5 (Tailwind CSS + HTMX)

scripts.dev:css: npm run build:js && tailwindcss -i resources/assets/css/app.css -o public/assets/css/app.css --watch
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.build:js: cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js public/assets/js/htmx.min.js && cp resources/assets/js/app.js public/assets/js/app.js
